packageRules.description: eve and the Upstash AgentKit extension are a matched pair: the extension's _manifest.json declares the contract versions it was built against, and `eve build` fails when the installed eve does not support them. Group them so neither moves alone.

eve 0.33 dropped hook contracts 1-9 (model identity moved from session.started runtime metadata to step.started call attribution); 0.33 supports only hook 10 and 0.34 supports 10-11. The newest extension, @upstash/agentkit-eve-extension@0.5.0, still requires hook 9 (plus tool 11, dynamicTool 12), so every eve >=0.33 fails `eve build`. Drop this rule once Upstash publishes an extension requiring hook contract >=10.
